purpose: Freeze the public-source bytes, chronology, canonical group identities, runtime/evaluator boundary, and candidate-construction design before any public state is materialized, labeled, generated, or fitted.

authorization.activation_rule: A separate promoted phase manifest must bind this candidate manifest's exact SHA256 and the exact implementation hashes. This candidate file cannot authorize itself.

ESConv.join_rule: manifest index and dialogue_id esconv_%04d must match the raw list position exactly; reordering or missing rows fails closed

ESConv.rule: all states and generator replicates from one raw dialogue remain in one group
ESConv.quarantine_rule: every manifest row marked excluded_for_evoemo_overlap is excluded from ESConv training, validation, and test use

EvoEmo.split_group_key: connected component of wrapper users linked by any shared raw session id
EvoEmo.shared_session_rule: p13 and p18 are inseparable for every outer split, but their runtime owners and private catalogs remain separate; no candidate may cross wrapper_user_id
EvoEmo.other_users: singleton connected components unless a future byte-identical or normalized-near-duplicate audit links them before labels

ES_MemEval.split_group_key: the same EvoEmo connected source-user component used by the response track
ES_MemEval.statistical_cluster: wrapper user with p13 and p18 bound in one resampling component for leakage-safe sensitivity

canonical_identity_and_grouping.constructed_family_rule: If any counterfactual family, template cluster, generator replicate family, or normalized near-duplicate component is later created, every member is bound to one split and its group key is recorded before labels or outcomes.

frozen_outer_folds.origin: outcome-blind session-balanced folds already frozen in v5_3_public_backbone_effect_learning_v1; retained because they bind p13 and p18 and do not depend on response outcomes
frozen_outer_folds.response_cross_fit_rule: for each held-out user, every learned representation, calibration, threshold, and PM parameter is fitted without that user's connected component
frozen_outer_folds.full_fit_rule: a final all-development-groups fit may be produced only after all grouped OOF predictions and head qualification decisions are frozen; it is not used to score those same public response states

ESConv_runtime_allowed: dialog[].content up to and including the current seeker turn
six-card RS candidate descriptors after production Rank-1 selection
ESConv_runtime_forbidden: observed supporter response selected as target gold
EvoEmo_runtime_allowed: basic_info except name as an owner-bound onboarding profile available before session 1
timestamp-normalized completed prior raw sessions for the same wrapper user
current raw dialogue prefix ending at the current seeker turn
literal exact-span MP, MS, and ME candidates compiled only from those allowed fields
six-card RS candidate descriptors after production Rank-1 selection
EvoEmo_runtime_forbidden: future session or future current-session turns
historical response outcome or PM prediction
ES_MemEval_generator_visible: the frozen QA system's permitted same-owner strictly-past raw history surface
ES_MemEval_evaluator_only: wrapper user id mapping when not operationally necessary
observability_boundary.physical_separation_rule: generator-visible and evaluator-only QA artifacts are separate files with separate hashes; no shared row object containing answer or evidence may be passed to the generator

common.state_grain: every eligible seeker turn with a nonempty current utterance; outcome-blind sampling may later choose a subset using visible structural strata only
common.strict_past: memory candidates may use completed prior sessions only; the current session never becomes memory for its own state
common.actual_rank1: freeze the exact production Rank-1 after structural gates and typed compilation; never promote Rank-2, edit the query, or relabel after annotations or response outcomes
common.candidate_absence: structural unavailable with component OFF; it is not a PM negative label
common.owner_failure: invalid candidate/retrieval row excluded from PM labels and reported to the responsible stage

MP_PROFILE.materialization: one exact key-value fact per nonempty permitted field, available from session 1
MP_PROFILE.ranking: frozen production typed candidate discovery; raw profile values may be rendered to the generator but dataset/user identity and fold are forbidden PM features
MP_PROFILE.not_authorized: social_relationship and any profile inferred from future dialogue

MS_SESSION.source: same-owner seeker utterances from timestamp-normalized completed prior raw sessions
MS_SESSION.materialization: one literal source turn per item after bounded atomic-session validation; no model-authored summary or observation
MS_SESSION.ranker_status: candidate binding only; activation still requires the P1 implementation manifest and local snapshot binding

ME_REUSABLE_OUTCOME.source: same-owner seeker utterances from timestamp-normalized completed prior raw sessions
ME_REUSABLE_OUTCOME.materialization: only literal within-turn action-result spans accepted by compile_atomic_reusable_outcome; no event timeline, summary, observation, or QA evidence
ME_REUSABLE_OUTCOME.ranker: production lexical plus typed-tier exact Rank-1 compile-or-OFF
ME_REUSABLE_OUTCOME.coverage_rule: low natural coverage is reported and may make the ME head fail qualification; no synthetic event may be inserted to rescue it

forbidden_substitutions: observed ESConv strategy annotation as oracle
different RS retriever for ESConv and EvoEmo

shared_candidate_discovery.status: candidate binding only; P1 implementation must prove owner, strict-past, compiler, exact-lineage, and Rank-1 invariants before activation

ESConv.train_nonoverlap: RS grouped OOF training and development-only measurement qualification; observed supporter strategy/response is not PM gold
ESConv.validation_nonoverlap: fresh RS measurement/threshold confirmation before final test; no test outcome feedback
ESConv.test_nonoverlap: 169-dialogue same-stack final RS response evaluation only

EvoEmo.response: six-fold cross-fitted MP_PROFILE, MS_SESSION, ME_REUSABLE_OUTCOME and auxiliary RS routing plus same-stack response evaluation
EvoEmo.confidence_unit: source user; state and generator replicate counts do not substitute for users

ES_MemEval.role: separate QA retrieval, multi-evidence, temporal/conflict/user-modeling, and abstention diagnostic

legacy_non_reuse.old_evoemo_204_state_panel: selection identities may be compared as an audit index only; old runtime_state and current_session_summary are forbidden
legacy_non_reuse.old_qa_418_gold: incomplete denominator and not reusable as the 1,427-question plan
legacy_non_reuse.old_suitability_labels: V3 and V5.3 labels are not public-backbone training gold under the active method

promotion_requirements: candidate manifest validator passes against source bytes and current active authority
a no-model P1 materializer implementation is separately hash-bound and tested with future/owner/gold negative canaries
planned output schemas are frozen, including separate runtime and evaluator-only QA schemas
source and candidate counts are measured without reading quality, risk, function, response, PM, or external outcomes
the active authority is promoted by naming the exact candidate-manifest and implementation hashes; this candidate file is not edited in place
